Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

-man I

  • Meaning: suff. indicating unreality after stressed word O/jB, esp. in condit. clauses (cf. GAG §§152d, 170h); OA cf. -min
  • Lines: a+8
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-man%20I

abnu I

  • Meaning: m. & f.; pl. abnū and abnātu(m) "stone" [NA4]
  • Logograms: NA4
  • Lines: b+22, b+25
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abnu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: a+10
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"
    • G: (a/u) NB ēnē a. 'fear the eyes' = "with an eye to, in consideration of"
    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB
    • Št: pass. of Š
    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB
  • Lines: a+14
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20II

ai I

  • Meaning: (before consonant), â, ya "not"
  • Lines: a+14
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 2'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 10', a+2, a+4, a+5, b+9
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 15', a+13, a+14, a+37, b+12
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 6', 9', a+5, a+7, a+8, a+15, a+19, a+31, a+33, a+35, a+40, b+4, b+7, b+14, b+21
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

annāma I

  • Meaning: OA, O/jB "there; thus, in this way"; jB, NA ~ "in the same way"; OB lex. + pron. suff. annāmašu "there he is";
  • Lines: a+29
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ann%C4%81ma%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: b+6, b+8
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

appu I

  • Meaning: f. "nose" Bab., M/NA [KIR4]
  • Logograms: KIR4
  • Lines: a+10
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/appu%20I

arkû I

  • Meaning: (NB cf. uškû I) "rear, later" [EGIR]
    • A.: of place
    • B.: of time
  • Logograms: EGIR
  • Lines: a+11
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ark%C3%BB%20I

attā I

  • Meaning: "you" (2 m. sg. pron.)
  • Lines: a+21, a+22
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/att%C4%81%20I

awû I

  • Meaning: "to speak"
    • G: (pret. īwu; stat. and 2 pers. sg. imper. awu) OA only
    • Gtn: iter. OA
    • Gt: (atwûm, later atmû) "speak" OA; O/jB(lit.) "discuss"; išti/itti X a. "negotiate with X"; ana X a. "tell X, speak to X"; OA "order (to do s.th.)"; jB itti libbīya (etc.) a. "think about" s.th.
  • Lines: a+32, a+34
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C3%BB%20I

awātu I

  • Meaning: "word; matter" [INIM]
  • Logograms: INIM
  • Lines: b+20
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C4%81tu%20I

awīlūtu I

  • Meaning: "humanity" [(NAM.)LÚ.U18/19.LU; LÚ- ]
  • Logograms: , , NAM.LÚ.LÚ.MEŠ
  • Lines: a+5, a+18, a+19
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C4%ABl%C5%ABtu%20I

Ayakku I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: b+9
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Ayakku%20I

ašābu I

  • Meaning: "to sit (down); dwell"
    • G: (Bab. a/i; imper. tišab, OA šib; OA stat. wašab, M/NA usbāku etc.; NA perf. ittūšib) [TUŠ; occas. TUŠ.A]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [TUŠ.TUŠ]
    • Gt: (cf. tašābu)
    • D: OB "settle" inhabitants; NB ~ "insert" s.th. (corrupt ?)
    • Š: caus. of G [TUŠ]
  • Logograms: TUŠ, TUŠ.A, TUŠ.TUŠ
  • Lines: a+36, b+19
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1%C4%81bu%20I

ašāšu III

  • Meaning: "to be distressed" OA, O/jB
    • G: (u/u; stat. also ašuš) [ZI.IR] "be aggrieved, angry"; jB once trans. "distress" s.o.
    • Gtn: iter. of G O/jB
    • Gt: ~ G OA
    • D: "grieve, distress" s.o., "torture, maltreat" s.o.
    • Dtn: iter. of D
    • Dt: "become distressed"
    • Št: ~ "grieve about s.th., pine away"
    • Ntn: "constantly become distressed"
  • Logograms: ZI.IR
  • Lines: 5'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1%C4%81%C5%A1u%20III

aššu I

  • Meaning: "because (of)" Bab., O/MA
  • Logograms: MU
  • Lines: b+23, b+25
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1%C5%A1u%20I

aṣû I

  • Meaning: "to go out", + vent. "come out" (from = ina, ištu, acc.)
    • G: (perf. ittaṣi, NA ittūṣi) [È; MB in PNs also UD]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [È.MEŠ]
    • Gt: separative of G "go away (for good)"
    • Š: Mari
    • Štn: pass. of Š
    • Št2: "quarrel, pick a fight"
  • Logograms: È, UD, È.MEŠ
  • Lines: b+11
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%E1%B9%A3%C3%BB%20I

bakû I

  • Meaning: "to weep"
    • G: (i/i) [ÉR] of human; of animal "cry"; also + dat. "weep over; weep for"
    • Gtn: iter. of G [ÉR.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G
  • Logograms: ÉR, ÉR.MEŠ
  • Lines: a+6
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bak%C3%BB%20I

balāṭu I

  • Meaning: "life" [TI(.LA); Am. TIL(.LA); NB also TIN] esp. ana balāṭ X "for X's life"; "vigour, good health"; OA balāṭukka "during your life-time"; O/MB lā balāṭu "loss of life"; O/jB(lit.) "(eternal) life"; šipat/šammi b. "life(-giving) spell/plant"; OB, Am. "provisions"; NA "food" for the gods; OA "(meagre) livelihood, small profit"; st. abs. Bogh., j/NB ana balāṭ 'within a life-time' = "next year";
  • Logograms: TI TI.LA, TIL TIL.LA, TIN
  • Lines: 8', a+11, a+17, a+20
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bal%C4%81%E1%B9%ADu%20I

balāṭu II

  • Meaning: "to live" [TI; TI.LA; TIN]
    • G: (u/u, Ass. a/a) stat. "is alive", "is healthy", OB "is solvent"; "live, stay alive, (be allowed to) live"; M/jB, Bogh. "be healed"; j/NB balāṭ napšāti "preservation of life"; OA of debt etc. "be revived, recognized"
    • D: of gods, people "bring back to life, revive"; MA "allow to stay alive", OB "let live; support, provide for"; O/jB "restore to health; cure"; OA, OB "recognize, credit" silver, goods to s.o.; OB "enact, validate" a document
    • Dt: Mari, jB "receive support, be maintained"
    • Š: Am. "give life to"
  • Logograms: TI, TI.LA, TIN
  • Lines: a+30
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bal%C4%81%E1%B9%ADu%20II

banû IV

  • Meaning: "to create; build"
    • G: (i/i) [DÙ] of deity "create" person, grain etc.; of person "engender" child, "make" figurine etc.; "build" house, boat; math. "construct"; ext. of feature "form" a shape
    • D: Am. "erect" city
    • Š: lit., caus. of G
    • N: pass.
  • Logograms: DÙ
  • Lines: a+18
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ban%C3%BB%20IV

bašû I

  • Meaning: "to be (at hand, available); exist" [GÁL]
    • G: (i/i; no perf.) "be in existence, available"; of eyes, ears "be fixed on, attentive"; of task, responsibility "lie with" s.o.; of power, characteristic "be owned" by s.o.; pret. ibši "was/were" (emphatic); M/NA pres. ibašši, also pl., as adv. ~ "really, in fact; some"; j/NB mala bašû "as much as there is available, everything, everybody"; adi lā bašê (infin.) 'until non-existence' of destruction, disease
    • Š: "bring into being"
    • N: ingress. of G
    • Ntn: "happen repeatedly"
  • Logograms: GÁL
  • Lines: 3', a+41
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ba%C5%A1%C3%BB%20I

būrtu I

  • Meaning: "cistern, well; fish pond; source (of river); hole, pit" Bab. [PÚ];
  • Logograms: PÚ
  • Lines: 3'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/b%C5%ABrtu%20I

dakāšu I

  • Meaning: ~ "to press in" O/jB
    • G: (a/u) om. of parts of body, stat. "are depressed"; jB med. "press on" s.o.; OB math. "press out, enlarge" geometrical figure
    • Gt: stat. tidkuš(at) "is pressed" OB of liver
    • D: ~ G of disease ? lex. only
  • Lines: 5'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/dak%C4%81%C5%A1u%20I

danniš I

  • Meaning: "very; severely";
  • Lines: a+1, a+3
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/danni%C5%A1%20I

dâlu I

  • Meaning: "to move, roam around" O/jB, NA
    • G: (ū) "walk, run around" of human, demon, fox, dog, NA of boat; NA "be active in service"; "prowl" of ghosts, demons
    • D: "disturb, disrupt" s.o.
    • Š: Mari "make s.o. run around"
  • Lines: 7', 10', a+16
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/d%C3%A2lu%20I

ebēbu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) bright, pure"
    • G: (i/i) "be clean" of hands, "clear" of illness, impurity, omen; "be free" of claims
    • D: [DADAG] "cleanse", "purify (ritually)", "keep pure"; leg. pūta ubbubu 'clear the forehead', i.e. "manumit"; "clear" s.o./o.s. of guilt, claims; "free" s.o. from duties; Mari "take census of"
    • Dt: [DADAG] "be purified, cleared"; Mari "be counted in census"
    • Š: ~ D NB "purify"
    • Štn: OB iter.
    • Št: NB pass. of Š
  • Logograms: DADAG
  • Lines: a+25
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/eb%C4%93bu%20I

ebēru I

  • Meaning: "to cross over"
    • G: (i/i) [BALA] river, sea, sky etc.; ext. "stretch over, lie across"
    • Gtn: iter. of G
    • Š: "make to cross, get s.o./s.th. across, bring across"
  • Logograms: BALA
  • Lines: a+39, b+25
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/eb%C4%93ru%20I

ekletu I

  • Meaning: (or iklētu(m)) "darkness" Bab. [KÚKKU]; bīt e. "dark chamber", "underworld";

(ana, ištu), also with poss. suff.; "(time of) year, the season"; pān(i) š. "spring"; warkiāt/arkât š. "later part of year"; rēš š. "new year"; NB mār š. "one-year-old" of animals; qīt š. "end of year"; šatta(m) (ana) šatti(m) etc. "year by year"; pl. "years = span of time", e.g. "years" of plenty;
  • Logograms: MU, MU.AN.NA, MU.X.ŠÈ, MU.KAM,
  • Lines: 12'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/%C5%A1attu%20I

šatû II

  • Meaning: "to drink" [NAG]
    • G: (i/i, pret. later ilti, NA issi) of human, god, animal; of plant, of field "be watered"; of cultivators "have access to water rights"
    • Gtn: iter. of G [med. NAG.NAG; NAG.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G OA (usu. cf. šaqû III)
  • Logograms: NAG, NAG.NAG, NAG.MEŠ
  • Lines: 4'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/%C5%A1at%C3%BB%20II

šebû I

  • Meaning: "to be full (of = acc.); be replete, satisfied (with)"
    • G: (i/i) of human, animal with food, drink; "be fully paid, satisfied with" money; with sleep, (long) life (balāṭa), old age (šībūta), roaming (atalluka), plenty (lalû etc.)
    • Gtn: iter. of G
    • D: "fill with, satisfy with (= acc.)"; "give" animals "their fill" to eat, drink; "satisfy, pay in full" with money, goods etc.; long life, plenty
    • Dt: pass. of D OA "be fully satisfied with (= acc.)" payment
    • N: ingress. "become satiated"
  • Lines: 13'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/%C5%A1eb%C3%BB%20I

šīmtu I

  • Meaning: st. constr. šīmti, occas. šimit "what is fixed; will, testament; fate, destiny" [NAM; NAM.TAR] OA "fixed (amount)"; "last will, testament", Nuzi ṭuppi š. "bequest tablet"; "fate, destiny" of (= decreed by) s.o.; god (fixer) of "fate(s)", lord of "fate(s)"; "destiny, lot" of (= decreed for) s.o.; ūm š. "predetermined day", ūm lā š. "premature death"; "(fate =) death, day of death"; ana š. alāku(m) = "to die a natural death";

šīru I

  • Meaning: often pl. "flesh; body; entrails (omen)" [UZU(.MEŠ)] "meat" of animals; organ š. lawi "is surrounded in flesh"; mê š. "meat broth"; "ominous part" examined in extispicy; "omen"; š. lemnum "unfavourable omen in entrails" etc.; human "flesh"; as famine food; in med., om.; š. ṭābu, ṭūb š. "good physical health"; OB "a person, individual"; "genetic stock", lā šīr "not of (our) flesh", š. ramāni "of own flesh"; š. u dāmu "flesh and blood"; OB deeds are sweet ana š. DN "to the person of DN, DN himself"?; "corporeal identity", stone becomes ana š. ili, mēsu-tree is š. ili
  • Logograms: UZU UZU.MEŠ

ṣabātu I

  • Meaning: "to seize, take; hold"
    • G: (a/a) [DAB]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] "continually engage in" prayers
    • Gt: (infin. etc. tiṣb...) [DAB(.DAB)] "hold one another", "wrestle", "be locked in combat", "engage in litigation"; of parts of body, liver etc. "be interlocked, grown together"; "hold fast" hand, emblem; stat. of ox
    • D: ~ G [DAB; DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] also "enclose, bind, set" with metal (bands); "fasten" roofbeams, thread; "occupy" city; "block" road; "claim" protection (kidinnu)
    • Dtn: iter. "repeatedly take possession of"
    • Dt: pass. of D Am. "be captured"
    • Š: caus. of G [DAB] "direct" s.o.'s attention (pānū) towards (ana); "equip, provide with" income, pasturage, water; often ellipt. "put in place, install" door; "launch" ship; "post" guard; "install" gate-sculptures; "settle" inhabitants; "cause to catch" fire, "ignite"; "make s.o. (start to) do s.th."
    • Štn: pass. of Š NB of work "be started on"
    • Št2: "make o.s. take", OA "gather up" silver; OB "get" troops, animals, tools "ready"; "execute" plan, decision
    • N: pass. of G [DAB]; ~ Gt OA, OB "seize one another", "litigate"
    • Ntn: ~ Gt "be interlocked, grown together"; of teeth "lock each other"
  • Logograms: DAB, DAB.DAB, DAB.MEŠ, DAB DAB.DAB
  • Lines: a+20
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/%E1%B9%A3ab%C4%81tu%20I

ṭehû I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) near to, approach"
    • G: (e/e) [TE; DA] of person, animal; for sexual intercourse; disease, evil; ship, arrow, stair, feature in exta; OA, OB leg. "approach with request, claim"; OB of harvest "approach"
